title: SCP-1027, Carnivorous Central Nervous System
description: A hostile living nervous system that hunts players and can seize control of nearby undead.
body:
The Carnivorous Central Nervous System adds a new creature. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-1027 also known as the Carnivorous Central Nervous System.


SCP-1027 resembles a fully exposed human nervous system that searches for living beings. It is extremely aggressive toward players and villagers, and it possesses the ability to take control of certain undead creatures, turning them into extensions of itself. SCP-1027 is fast and highly dangerous, capable of overwhelming victims quickly and creating new instances upon killing them.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-1027 spawn?

SCP-1027 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-1027.
</details>



![SCP-1027](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b844913f51e5b813860400ad748913244bf10ba.png)

SCP-1027 is a human central nervous system that spawns at the surface during night. It is aggressively hostile toward players and villagers, rushing at them with sudden leaps. It also does not drown. SCP-1027 seeks out zombies, husks, zombified piglins, drowned, and zombie villagers, taking control of them to use as additional attackers. When SCP-1027 kills a player or villager, a new instance immediately forms, allowing the anomaly to spread rapidly.
